rules.name: Core Curriculum
rules.desc:
Students must enroll in CSRE 100 or one of the Comparative Core courses (CSRE 101A, 101B, or 101C) before they can declare the minor in CSRE.
Please note that students are encouraged to begin the declaration process as soon as possible. The minor will be tagged as “pending” until CCSRE confirms enrollment in one of the gateway courses.
Language courses do not count toward CSRE minor requirements.

rules.name: CSRE Electives (20 units)

limits.label: DAAAS, ASNAMST, CHILATST, JEWISHST and NATIVEAM courses

rules.desc:
CSRE minors must complete the remaining units of their 30-unit minimum with elective coursework in CSRE, with the exception below.
CSRE minors may count up to 10 units of coursework listed in the Department of African and African American Studies (DAAAS), Asian American Studies (ASNAMST), Chicana/o-Latina/o Studies (CHILATST), Jewish Studies (JEWISHST), and/or Native American Studies (NATIVEAM) toward their elective coursework in the CSRE minor.

grading: A minimum grade of C- is required for a student to count a class towards the Core Curriculum, including the Gateway and Comparative Core. Additional units toward the minor require a passing grade of D- or above. Student may count 1 class with Satisfactory/No Credit (SNC) grading basis toward Additional Units.
policies: No more than 5 units of petitioned courses that are not listed under CCSRE or cross-listed with CCSRE may be applied to the CSRE minor. Students who wish to petition a course must fill out and submit a course petition for the CCSRE Academic Programs team to review within one month of completing their annual degree audit meeting with the CCSRE Student Services Officer.
transferPolicy: Up to ten units of external credit may be applied toward elective coursework in the minor.
reviewNotes: The audit checks the 30 units of the minor: CSRE 100 and one Comparative Core course (CSRE 101A, 101B or 101C), each letter graded with a C- or better, and 20 units of electives from the CCSRE family with a passing grade, at most 10 of them from AFRICAAM, ASNAMST, CHILATST, JEWISHST or NATIVEAM courses (a CSRE course cross-listed there counts too). Language courses do not count, and at most one elective (5 units) may be S/NC. You check by hand petitioned courses from outside CCSRE (at most 5 units).
